content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm trying to obtain the communications protocol for the [product_name] unit. My aim is to develop a simple SCADA system using software like Visual Basic, which would allow monitoring various values and statuses from the application. I want the package to gather info from up to 32 units across the site. This seems feasible, since it's possible to do similar monitoring with the [product_name] software, although for only one device at a time. While [company_name] isn't known for sharing protocols openly, having this info would benefit OEMs like myself who wish to further expand on the product.

Hi [user_name], I agree with your earlier point. [company_name] is unlikely to disclose details of the [product_name] communication protocol. But what is your reason for choosing [product_name]? The price difference between [product_name] Pure and a [product_name] CPU isn't significant. With [product_name] CPU, you can visualize data via OPC (e.g. PC-Access) and build your own Visual Basic interface, or even use [product_name] visualization tools. If you still wish to use [product_name], connecting 32 devices and building your own protocol will be a challenge, perhaps requiring a month of development. Sorry I can't provide solutions, but maybe there's an alternative we can discuss together.

Hello, You can try using a port monitoring tool, such as the one on [url], to observe communication between the [product_name] and your PC. It's quite straightforward—I use the same method myself. (Apologies for my English.) Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants highlight the need for official communications protocol documentation for [product_name] to enable integration with custom SCADA applications. Current company policy restricts access to such information, which hampers OEMs and developers seeking to connect multiple devices and extend system functionality. Without protocol access, scalability and advanced automation solutions are limited.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect open and accessible documentation for the [product_name] communication protocol to facilitate integration with third-party and custom software solutions. They hope [company_name] will support expansion opportunities by providing the technical resources needed for OEM and developer projects.
